summary: Grayscale Ethereum Staking Mini ETF filed an 8-K announcing a proposed Third Amended and Restated Declaration of Trust to facilitate quarterly distributions of net cash proceeds from staking rewards to shareholders. The Sponsor determined the amendment is not materially adverse and necessary to comply with IRS Revenue Procedure 2025-31 on grantor trust staking. Twenty days prior notice is provided. No financial terms or premiums are disclosed. Watch for shareholder feedback and IRS guidance developments.
